sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Where are you headed?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: Take me to the W hotel.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Sure.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: Could you speed up? I’m running a little late.
sentences.ko: 더 빨리 가주실 수 있나요? 조금 늦을 것 같아서요.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Alright. I’ll go as fast as I can.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: Keep going straight and please turn right up ahead.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: Let me out over there.

title: Does my room rate include breakfast?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Do you have a reservation?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: Yes. I have a reservation.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: And my reservation is under Peter.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: I’d like a room with a view on a lower floor.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Actually, we’ve upgraded you to a suite.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: Wow! Thanks!

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: Does my room rate include breakfast?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Yes. And breakfast is served from 6:30 to 10:30 a.m.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Here’s your key, and the bellboy will deliver your luggage to your room.
sentences.ko: 열쇠는 여기 있습니다. 벨보이가 짐을 객실로 가져다드릴 것입니다.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Can you direct me to the shoe store?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: It’s on the second floor. May I help you?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: No, thanks. I’m just browsing.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: This is exactly what I was looking for!
sentences.ko: 이게 바로 제가 찾고 있던 거예요!

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Do you have this in a brighter shade?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: I’m sorry. That’s our only yellow.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: How can I help you?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: Hi, I’d like to sign up for the yoga class.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: We are having various promotional events now.
sentences.ko: 저희가 지금 다양한 행사를 진행하고 있어요.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: Are you offering any discounts?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Yes. We’re offering a 20% discount.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: The original price is 96 dollars, but it is 76 dollars and 80 cents during the promotion.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Have you had breakfast?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: Yes. How about you?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: I had a cup of tea just now. What did you have for your breakfast?
sentences.ko: 방금 차 한잔 마셨어. 넌 아침 뭐 먹었어?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: I had a scrambled egg and a cup of coffee.
sentences.ko: 스크램블 에그랑 커피 한 잔 마셨어.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: Why don’t you have any food for your breakfast?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: I am not used to having food in the morning.
sentences.ko: 난 아침을 먹는 게 익숙하지 않아.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: If I do so, I’ll have a problem with my belly.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.en: How about milk? Is it OK for you to drink milk in the morning?
sentences.ko: 우유를 마시는 건 어때? 아침에 우유 마시는 건 괜찮아?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.en: Milk is OK with me. But a cup of tea or coffee is enough for me.
sentences.ko: 우유는 괜찮은데 그냥 차나 커피 한잔하는 것도 난 충분해.
